title: 第21章 烂泥虫第22章 求偶期
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
第21章烂泥虫
烂泥虫，是御兽大陆最低等的一种生物。
这种生物常年生活在阴暗潮湿的角落里，身上还散发着阵阵恶臭。这种生物哪怕是一个凡人小孩都能随手捏死，但偏偏极其容易繁衍，经常冷不丁就出现在哪个角落中。
不管是谁，一旦看到烂泥虫，第一反应都是踩死捏死。
现在。
楚风眠，林颜，还有霸天虎，被神兽大人和这种生物并列，这话语中的厌恶，扑面而来。
也没有人怀疑是宋荞假传神兽意志，这牌子上的神兽气息，谁也不会认错！
林颜看着这牌子，脸色顿时惨白。
神兽大人……竟还留了这样一个牌子给宋荞，这是根本没有打算给她留任何脸面。
楚风眠、林颜、霸天虎和烂泥虫不得入内。
林颜甚至能够想象到，众人在背后一边说着这句话，一边嘲讽地场景。
她的身体，不由摇摇欲坠了起来。
“颜儿。”楚风眠赶忙扶住了林颜。
宋方已经忍不住狂笑了起来，他看向陈戈：“陈戈，你叫我们来，就是让我们看这个？好了，现在大家都知道了，你家这几个玩意儿是跟烂泥虫一样的玩意儿。”
宋方现在，怎一个快意了得。
原本，他是做好准备，要听陈戈吹一波牛逼的。
现在好了，陈戈拉了那么多人过来，大家没能见证到霸天虎的所谓进步，反而是眼睁睁看着他们出了天大的丑！
陈戈的脸色也有些难看，他最是要面子不过，否则，也不会特意邀请来这么多人。
但现在，林颜和霸天虎不但没能为他争来面子，反而让他的脸落到了地上，被众人狂踩！
“到底怎么回事？”陈戈咬了咬牙。

他费了多少心思，才让霸天虎有了接受神兽指导的机会。
结果，它才去了一天，就被神兽大人厌恶至此？
林颜的嘴唇颤抖着，一时不知道说什么好。
楚风眠一脸愤怒地看向宋荞：“师尊，都是这个宋荞使用手段，是她故意陷害我们，才导致神兽大人对我们有了误会！”
陈戈顿时冷冷看向宋荞：“宋荞！灵兽蛋的事情，不是说了，已经了结了吗？你竟然还怀恨在心，乃至于陷害同门！灵心宗，怎么会有你这种无德无能的弟子！”
“陈戈，你放狗屁！”宋方急了，他撸起袖子就要跟陈戈干架。
陈戈丝毫不慌，他冷笑了一声：“你宋方暴躁无礼，纵得宋荞也是骄纵跋扈。这一点，灵心宗上下，谁人不知谁人不晓？说宋荞得罪神兽大家都信，我这两个弟子一向与人和善，他们要不是被陷害，怎么会被神兽这般厌恶？”
宋荞眯了眯眼睛。
比起爷爷，陈戈明显更圆滑一些，人缘也要更好一些。
之前的原主，最多是有些大小姐脾气，也不算什么大事。
但楚风眠在外面，却一直宣扬原主有多么骄纵，说他有多么不容易。
时间长了，宋方和宋荞在宗门里的人缘的确是不怎么样。
但，事情总是会发生改变的。
宋荞拦下即将要暴走的宋方，淡然看向陈戈：“被陷害？陈长老的意思是，神兽大人没有一点明辨是非的能力，竟然被我一个小辈牵着鼻子走？既然你是这么觉得的，走，我们一起去面见神兽大人，看看大人怎么说。”
第21章烂泥虫
宋荞说着，就要拉陈戈去见神兽。
陈戈的脸色变了变。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Mud Worm
Mudworms are the lowest creatures in the Beast Control Continent.
This creature lives in dark and damp corners all year round, and its body exudes a foul odor. This kind of creature can easily crush even a mortal child to death, but it is extremely easy to reproduce and often appears unexpectedly in any corner.
No matter who it is, once they see a mud bug, their first reaction is to crush it to death.
Now.
Chu Fengmian, Lin Yan, and the Decepticons were juxtaposed with this creature by the mythical beast. The disgust in these words rushed to their faces.
No one doubts that Song Qiao is pretending to convey the will of the mythical beast. No one can mistake the aura of the mythical beast on this brand!
Lin Yan looked at the sign and turned pale.
Lord Divine Beast... actually left such a sign for Song Qiao. He had no intention of saving her any face.
Chu Fengmian, Lin Yan, Decepticons and Mudworms are not allowed to enter.
Lin Yan could even imagine the scene of people saying these words behind his back, while mocking him.
Her body couldn't help but sway.
"Yan'er." Chu Fengmian quickly supported Lin Yan.
Song Fang couldn't help but laugh wildly. He looked at Chen Ge: "Chen Ge, you called us here just to show us this? Okay, now everyone knows that these things in your house are the same as mud bugs."
Song Fang is so happy now.
Originally, he was prepared to listen to Chen Ge's bragging.
Well now, Chen Ge brought so many people over, but everyone failed to witness the so-called progress of the Decepticons. Instead, they watched them make a big mistake!
Chen Ge's face was also a little ugly. He wanted to save face the most, otherwise, he wouldn't have specially invited so many people.
But now, Lin Yan and the Decepticons not only failed to win face for him, but instead made his face fall to the ground and be trampled by everyone!
"What's going on?" Chen Ge gritted his teeth.
He put in a lot of effort to give the Decepticons the opportunity to receive guidance from the mythical beasts.
As a result, it had only been there for a day and it was so disgusted by the mythical beast?
Lin Yan's lips trembled, and she didn't know what to say.
Chu Fengmian looked at Song Qiao with an angry look on his face: "Master, it was Song Qiao's use of tricks. She deliberately framed us, which caused Master Divine Beast to misunderstand us!"
Chen Ge immediately looked at Song Qiao coldly: "Song Qiao! Hasn't the matter of the spirit beast egg been discussed and settled? You still hold a grudge and even framed a fellow sect! Lingxin Sect, how can there be such an immoral and incompetent disciple as you!"
"Chen Ge, what nonsense are you talking about!" Song Fang was anxious. He rolled up his sleeves and started to fight with Chen Ge.
Chen Ge didn't panic at all, he sneered: "You Song Fang is irritable and rude, even Song Qiao is arrogant and domineering. Everyone in the Lingxin Sect knows this? Everyone believes that Song Qiao offended the divine beast. My two disciples have always been kind to people. If they were not framed, how could they be so disgusted by the divine beast?"
Song Qiao narrowed his eyes.
Compared with his grandfather, Chen Ge is obviously more diplomatic and more popular.
The previous original owner had a bit of a young lady's temper at most, which was not a big deal.
But Chu Fengmian was outside and kept preaching how arrogant the original owner was and how difficult it was for him.
As time went by, Song Fang and Song Qiao's popularity in the sect was indeed not very good.
But, things always change.
Song Qiao stopped Song Fang, who was about to run away, and looked at Chen Ge calmly: "Framed? What Elder Chen means is that the Divine Beast has no ability to distinguish right from wrong, and he is led by the nose by a junior like me? Since you think so, let's go and meet the Divine Beast together and see what he says."

Song Qiao said that he was about to drag Chen Ge to see the mythical beast.
Chen Ge's expression changed.
